title: AutoCAD, AutoLISP, and .NET Quick-Start Automation Kit

star.situation: A CAD team has trusted AutoCAD routines, but standards, layers, attributes, plots, and support paths are too fragile to automate blindly.
star.task: Create a public-safe quickstart that proves a request package can be validated before a native AutoLISP or AutoCAD .NET adapter changes drawings.
star.action: Scan approved GDAL DXF/DWG fixtures, classify runtime needs, produce validation checks, and show native command scaffolds for AutoLISP and AutoCAD .NET.
star.result: Peers and technical interviewers can run the public kit, inspect the report, then discuss where a licensed AutoCAD runtime would take over.

fixtures.use: DXF entity and layer smoke fixture.
DWG package-presence fixture; native geometry inspection remains runtime-gated.

developmentPreviewWarning: This CAD library is in development. This is an early public preview for feedback on the best business case, workflow shape, and proof path.
publicBoundary: Public kit contains approved public fixtures, code examples, validation reports, and native adapter scaffolds only.
